desc: The second screen's window (TTYD_COMPANION_WINDOW) keeps its own ImGui context current 8 ms more every frame (TTYD_COMPANION_HOLD_MS) while Aurora's render worker draws the game's ImGui frame (the performance overlay's, so that there is one every frame): the worker draws it with Aurora's context and backend, never the window's (aurora patch 0064; before it, ImGui_ImplWGPU_RenderDrawData crashed on the window's backend data). The harbour (gor_00) to control and up the pier, on Vulkan: the game plays on and both windows draw
